pr_body:
This PR makes Tree call `update()` when adding new item, removing or freeing. Also I refactored some conditions.

Fixes #38787
Fixes #50318
Supersedes #39662
pr_comments: This doesn't cherry-pick for `3.x`, the `_change_tree` method doesn't seem to exist there.

issue_context.title: TreeItem remove_child doesn't immediately update the UI
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v3.3.2.stable.official

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

When removing an item from a Tree node using TreeItem.remove_child, the UI doesn't get updated immediately.  
It will only update the UI when moving the mouse from outside the game window to the inside, or if you click an item in the Tree.

### Steps to reproduce

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12375347/125121966-04f97a00-e0f5-11eb-8856-e506212a697f.mp4

### Minimal reproduction project

[TreeRemoveChild.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/6793307/TreeRemoveChild.zip)

review_comments: Actually, `_change_tree()` will update both trees, so this can be even removed.
No, it's necessary because _change_tree does nothing if the source and destination trees are the same.
